title: {Syn} Mixture-of-Experts Models Route Tokens to Specialists
content:
Mixture-of-experts architectures activate only part of a model for each token, routing inputs to selected expert subnetworks.

The appeal is computational efficiency: a model can have many parameters while using a smaller active subset per step, though routing and load balancing become new challenges.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
